planned_workout.note: Adjusted for a ~10-day layoff since the last Back day (08-31) plus back/leg stress from moving this week. Rows prioritized per the standing push/pull-correction rule; Pullover/Dead Hang de-emphasized.

exercises.reasoning: ~12% off the PR weight — same reps, lighter load to reassess after the layoff before pushing back toward 97kg

exercises.name: Low Row
exercises.reasoning: ~11% down, one fewer rep target — your biggest pull corrector, worth keeping in the session but not maxed

exercises.name: Reverse Incline DB Row
exercises.reasoning: Back to your established comfortable range (24-26kg) rather than continuing the recent weight-step, given the extra back fatigue this week

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.reasoning: Weakest corrector anyway (net-pull-positive but diluted) — light or drop entirely if the back feels anything but fully warmed up

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.reasoning: Zero ratio benefit either way (forearm-dominant) — no reason to grind it under back fatigue, just maintain grip/hang pattern
